finding: Train-A SAME pairs were Y/X-adjacent while all reviewed DIFFERENT pairs were Z-adjacent. The initial nearest-token extraction also made many direct XY neighbors identical under CPDINO's stride-8 token grid.
consequence: Its apparent AUC=1.0 cannot be interpreted as neuron-boundary separability and cannot select a Cellpose representation or authorize affinity-head training.
remediation: The versioned extractor now bilinearly interpolates the token grid and emits a fail-closed axis-confounding gate. Frozen labels and all original receipts remain unchanged.
